description: Deliver as a GitLab merge request per repository (glab CLI).

review.instructions: Export the MR discussion (`glab mr view <n> --comments`) to a markdown file and pass it to `sdlc handback`.

ship.note: Commits as git.user, pushes with git.sshCommand, opens the MR with `glab` (check `glab auth status` shows the project's account).

steps: ship again on the same branch; the push updates the open MR
